name: Lakhotia Polyesters (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Lakhotia Polysters (India) Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and selling of Metallic Yarn & Textile Fabrics.
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1][2]
Company specializes in lacquered metallized Polyesters film. Grade of coated Polyesters film produced is used extensively in the manufacture of metallic yarns.
a) Transfer Foil 
b) Silted M type yarn
c) MH type yarn
d) MX type yarn
e) ST type yarns
f) Glitter Powder
g) LAC coated metallized polyester films

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 117% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 114 days to 88.7 days
cons: Stock is trading at 3.83 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.12.9 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 188 days.
